# Davonium Technologies

## Our products and current status
- Ready2Go Learning — In development. We are building a learning and exam-practice experience for JAMB candidates and students. https://ready2go.davoniumtech.com/
- Marvel Chat — Built; active development. The initial build exists and we continue testing and refinement. https://marvelchat.davoniumtech.com/
- Davonium Nexus — In development. We are building a workspace for project status, deliverables, and client handoff. https://www.davoniumtech.com/docs/guides/davonium-nexus

## Site implementation and boundaries
We publish this website as static HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. We provide responsive layouts, a system-aware light/dark theme, documentation filtering over ordinary links, optional PWA installation, selected offline caching, page metadata, structured data, and an XML sitemap. Installation and offline behaviour depend on the browser, device, network, and resources already cached.

Our contact form prepares an email in the visitor’s mail application; it does not store submissions or create a server-side ticket. Our privacy, terms, and browser-storage pages are drafts pending review against actual production practices and applicable requirements.

## Discovery and citation note
We permit public crawling through robots.txt, including OAI-SearchBot for ChatGPT search discovery. Search engines and AI services decide independently whether to crawl, index, rank, summarize, cite, or surface our pages. These files describe our public site; they do not guarantee visibility or endorsement.
